title: refactor(ci): unify workflows, optimize cache + reduce matrix parallelism
author: Aisha Patel
description: Unify and simplify GitHub Actions workflows across the monorepo, reduce build matrix parallelism to improve build-cache hit rate, and standardize reusable workflow usage and cache keys. Motivation: noisy CI spikes, low cache hit rates for our lint/test/release matrices, and duplicated maintenance across many workflow files. This PR consolidates lint/test/release pipelines into a set of reusable workflows, centralizes cache key logic, bumps GH Actions for security/hygiene, and adds heuristics to favor fewer matrix axes for packages with long build graphs. Changes include actionable cache key templates, shared steps for install/test/lint, and lightweight gating for release automation to reduce flakiness. Checklist: [x] baseline perf measurements, [x] update reusable workflow templates under .github/workflows/reusable/, [x] update top-level workflows in major packages, [x] bump actions/setup-node and actions/cache to latest recommended versions, [x] verify SDK builds (python/typescript/go), [x] smoke-run release workflow on staging. Impact: expected substantial improvement to build-cache hit rates and reduced overall CI concurrency cost. Rollout plan: staged merge to main, monitor CI cache hit and average queue time for 48h, revert patch in case of widespread failures. Notes: description is intentionally consolidated to make review comments linear and searchable.
